title: Behavior-Flag Migration Audit & Compatibility Scaffold for Streaming+Toolcall APIs
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: As we roll out behavior flags to toggle between legacy streaming/toolcall semantics and the new structured-output-first contract, we need an auditable, repeatable migration path that minimizes customer regressions. This ticket builds a compatibility scaffold: a flag matrix generator, deterministic replay harness for multi-segment streaming + toolcall flows, and an automated schema validator that runs against golden prompt suites.

Goals: 
- Produce a canonical behavior flag matrix mapping flag combinations to concrete runtime behaviors for streaming, tool/function calling, and structured outputs. 
- Implement a deterministic replayer that can run recorded client interactions (stream chunks, tool call handshakes, final structured payloads) against both legacy and new codepaths and surface semantic diffs. 
- Add a compatibility gate to CI that fails on output-schema regressions or tokenization drift beyond configurable thresholds. 
- Provide a phased canary plan: shadow runs, dual-write telemetry, and a progressive rollout policy with automatic rollback on SLO regressions.

Approach: 
1) Flag matrix CSV generator (infra): enumerate all meaningful boolean/exclusive flags (stream_chunked_mode, toolcall_sync, structured_output_enforcement, strict_schema_validation, chunk_idempotency) and produce human-friendly docs + machine-readable matrix for automated test harnesses.
2) Replay harness: extend existing shadow-run framework to capture: request headers, input prompt boundary markers, token stream fragments with timing, toolcall invocation frames, and final model-side structured output. Replayer will feed captured streams into both legacy and new handlers to detect behavioral divergences.
3) Golden prompt suite: author ~120 prompts covering: long-horizon streaming, interleaved toolcalls, nested toolcall->toolcall handoffs, truncation/continuation edge cases, and required structured fields missing/extra cases.
4) CI integration: new job "compatibility-scan" that runs the replayer across the flag matrix in parallel for core commits to runtime and API layers; failures produce a reproducible package (capture + failing-diff).
5) Rollout: initial internal opt-in (engineering-only) -> partner opt-in (selected enterprise customers) -> public default toggle with 4-week sunset plan.

Out-of-scope: automatic client SDK migrations and end-user docs for every language (handled by PM and DevRel after stability checks).

Acceptance criteria (summary): 
- Flag matrix published in Confluence and checked into infra as CSV.
- Replay harness can reproduce 95% of captured contact points deterministically across 10 seed recordings.
- CI compatibility-scan job runs within 30 minutes for a reduced flag subset, and failures produce an artifact that includes a delta report and captured inputs.
- Rollout playbook (internal) with rollback thresholds and telemetry dashboards documented.
acceptance_criteria: Flag matrix CSV checked into repo and linked from Confluence page
Deterministic replayer reproduces captured streaming+toolcall interactions for >=95% of seed recordings
Compatibility CI job is added to runtime and sdk pipelines and creates attachable failure artifacts
Schema validator flags unexpected/missing required output fields with clear error categories
Canary plan documented and approved by SRE and Product with rollback thresholds
